differences.a_observable: The 'Secure Payments' card is framed closely, dominating the center of the screen.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further away, showing a wider view of the surrounding card grid.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera distance and focal length to match the tighter framing of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The shadows cast beneath the cards are deep and sharp, creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are faint and soft, resulting in a flatter overall image.
differences.fix: Increase key light intensity and adjust shadow density to deepen the contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: The white cards exhibit a subtle matte texture with soft edge highlights.
differences.b_observable: The cards appear perfectly smooth and glossy, showing sharper specular reflections.
differences.fix: Increase the roughness value of the card material to achieve a matte finish.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera position and focal length to match the tighter framing and perspective of the reference video.
